name: PocketAssistantCards
description: An interactive 3-column stitched pocket deck with 9 swappable AI note cards, drag-to-pull spring physics, live recipe scalers & checklists, clickable trail map waypoints, essay structure highlighters, and optional Web Audio paper-slide SFX.

checkpoints.name: v1: Initial AI Creation
checkpoints.description: A tactile 3-column stitched pocket card showcase with tilted AI assistant notes that smoothly peek on hover and pull out on click for full readability.

checkpoints.name: v2: Fixed center card z-index clipping & bottom overflow, refined left/right card vertical alignment so text isn't cut off, upgraded to crisp SVG stitch borders, and improved dark-mode lavender flap visibility.
checkpoints.description: Fixed center card z-index clipping & bottom overflow, refined left/right card vertical alignment so text isn't cut off, upgraded to crisp SVG stitch borders, and improved dark-mode lavender flap visibility.

checkpoints.name: v3: Upgraded PocketAssistantCards to v3: 9-card multi-deck (3 cards per pocket) with shuffle pills, drag-to-pull spring physics, live recipe checklist + 1x/2x scaler, interactive waypoint map pins, essay structure highlighter chips, bespoke SVG stickers, and optional Web Audio paper-slide SFX.
